name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months, directly to the bank accounts of eligible farmer families.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a landholding farmer (individual or family) as per state land records.
Cultivable landholding in the applicant's name (or the family's name) as of Feb 1, 2019, or updated records.
Family defined as: husband, wife, and minor children.
Excluded: farmer families where any member is a serving/retired government employee (except Group D/Class IV employees).
Excluded: farmer families where any member is a current or former minister, MP, MLA, mayor, or district panchayat chairperson.
Excluded: farmer families where any member pays income tax in the last assessment year.
Excluded: professionals like doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants registered with professional bodies and practicing.
No age restriction, but applicant must be an Indian citizen.
required_documents: Bank account details (passbook or cancelled cheque)
application_mode: Online via pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centres (CSC)
